title: Notify the EPA of contaminated land
what: Report to the CEO, within 21 days, any site the business (as owner, occupier or polluter) knows or suspects is contaminated.

sources.title: Contaminated Sites Act 2003 (WA)
sources.quote: Except as provided in subsection (5), a person referred to in subsection (4) must report to the CEO any site that the person — (a) knows is contaminated, within 21 days after the day on which the person first knew that the site was contaminated

reach.condition: if it owns or occupies, or has contaminated, a site it knows or suspects is contaminated
